notes.title: Synchro playtest has ended!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]We have closed the Synchro playtest on Steam until the next major update. Thank you to everyone who participated! This is incredibly valuable. Thanks to your feedback, we've understood and improved a lot of things, and we continue to make improvements![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here's a bit of statistics:[/b][/p][p]The playtest was approved for 3054 people;[/p][p]1482 people made it into the game and played;[/p][p]We received 700 feedback forms from you;[/p][p]The median playtime was 40 minutes;[/p][p]The average overall game score based on ratings from the latest build: 7.75.[/p][p]The approximate percentage of positive reviews: 85%.[/p][p] [/p][p]We considered reviews with a score of 6 and below as negative, and those with a score of 7 and above as positive.[/p][p]Among the issues, we can highlight bugs, problems with the movement mechanics, and the fact that the original gameplay experience often turned out to be difficult and unclear even for experienced turn-based tactics players.[/p][p]We'll also share the successful aspects: positive feedback on the synchronous battles mechanic, players were delighted with the game world and its references, as well as the visual style, and many enjoyed the setting.[/p][p][/p][p]Creating big, interesting, and good games is only possible by relying on player feedback.[/p][p][b]Thank you to everyone who believed in us![/b][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Synchro featured in the RPG Direct Festival!
notes.notes:
[p]That’s right — we’re in! Synchro has joined the RPG Direct festival, and we’re thrilled to be part of this celebration of all things role-playing. Be sure to check out the festival page — it’s packed with amazing indie RPG:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/nokogodo/sale/rpgdirect2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/nokogodo/sale/rpgdirect2025[/url][/p][p]And don’t miss the major updates we’ve rolled out for Synchro’s demo during the open playtest! We’ve added multiple difficulty levels, revamped the combat system to make it more clear, and enhanced the Spirit Vision mechanic — it now reveals the lies hidden behind corporate billboards:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/827c5fb8d9c3846db31261c24a50871da11ba136.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your feedback means the world to us. Play the updated demo, try out the new features, and let us know what you think! You can join the open playtest directly from our Steam page — just click that one button:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/7c359295f40f158a44ab65861106b6f5e81edb64.png"][/img]
[/p]

notes.title: Difficulty levels in the latest update for the demo on open playtest
notes.notes: [p]Hey there![/p][p]Great news — the latest Synchro update introduces three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard![/p][p]If the game felt too hardcore or unclear before, now’s the perfect time to give it another shot on Easy or Normal. We’ve made combat much easier to grasp for players who don’t want to predict enemy attacks or dashes — now they have nowhere to hide![/p][p]You can switch the difficulty level at any time from the settings menu.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback — especially on the new difficulty options![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/72627dadd702f95421c6f2e6fbd7d70229370f1a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Oh, and one more thing — Synchro is part of #TurnBasedThursdayFest on Steam![/p][p]Check out the festival page to discover even more awesome turn-based games:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/turnbasedthursdayfest2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/turnbasedthursdayfest2025[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Synchro Playtest 0.1.2 — Bugfixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
Playtests are still underway, and we’re incredibly grateful to everyone who’s already joined and shared their impressions! Your kind words and positive feedback truly inspire us to keep improving. Huge thanks also to those who’ve given us constructive feedback — your input is incredibly valuable for shaping the future of the game!

If you haven’t launched the game yet or ran into issues earlier, there's good news: we’ve just updated the game, fixed a number of problems, and made the following improvements:

- Fixed known bugs causing freezes/crashes
- Resolved a bug that prevented alternative banner versions from displaying on AMD cards
- Movement is now smoother and faster
- Added tips to the loading screen
- Fixed an issue with displaying attack order correctly

We’re also working on adding a difficulty level, so everyone can find a play style that suits them. On top of that, we're refining the Eye of Truth mechanic — which lets you see an alternate version of in-game billboards. This feature will play a much bigger role in the gameplay down the line, so stay tuned for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/412058c3b3257fb533fbb88f2afeb83cbeac91ad.jpg[/img]

Lastly, we’re planning a revamp of the demo’s beginning: expect an epic boss battle and more lore about the world of Synchro.

If you’re still encountering any issues with playtest, please let us know — we carefully review all feedback and will do our best to address everything in future updates.

notes.title: Devlog #1: We are working on a location in a post-apocalyptic atmosphere
notes.notes:
Greetings, leader! Komisoft team is in touch and in our debut devlog we'll talk about the district called Chov, which we are currently working on.

Chov is the outskirts of the city, located between the technological metropolis of Solar-30 and the mysterious giant dome hiding the sinister secrets of the SmartPlast corporation. This is a wild and dangerous area, reminiscent of the world of the post-apocalypse. In the dense forests, swamps and ugly abandoned buildings, you'll find the remains of huge old machines, encounter the tracks and lairs of crazed cultists. What other dangers are hidden under an unreliable layer of snow? 

After overcoming the difficulties, you'll find forgotten resources, unique equipment and other useful items to develop the rebel base and upgrade your heroes.

Currently, we are actively drawing the locations of Chov and modeling the enemies inhabiting it. Some of the locations are already nearing their final appearance:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/a63f3cef8a2f6fdb949163a1a1a67f5970038c88.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/80a39f9ca238da9152d835f97bbe439fe8e00ab0.jpg[/img]

Some arts are concept at the moment::

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/4f08799a37a996282d91c9ea0194ff448784993d.jpg[/img]

We are also working on cultists. Some cultists look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/8a887d4005ebcaddfdfd1689b3a2639ecb3b889f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924534/9489a9b4ac24fbcc02dcebdbbbb36639a6534825.jpg[/img]

In addition to working on new locations, we are also finishing up a public demo for Steam, which we plan to release in the first quarter of next year. Tell your friends and social networks about Synchro Bright Future. And we will be happy to hear your opinion on the art and concepts we have showed, because your feedback will help make the game even better!
